description: This file implements a memory service class (Mem0MemoryService) for Pipecat, integrating with Mem0 to store and retrieve conversational memories, and enhancing LLM context with relevant past interactions. It includes configuration parameters, message storage, memory retrieval, and context enhancement methods, as well as frame processing logic.

classes.name: Mem0MemoryService
classes.description: A class that provides a memory service integrating with Mem0, capable of storing and retrieving memories, and enhancing LLM contexts with relevant past conversations.

classes.name: Mem0MemoryService.InputParams
classes.description: Configuration parameters for the Mem0MemoryService, including search limits, thresholds, API version, system prompt, message addition mode, and position.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the Mem0MemoryService with optional API key, local configuration, user/agent/run IDs, parameters, and host. Sets up the memory client and validates required IDs.

methods.name: _store_messages
methods.description: Stores a list of messages in Mem0, with optional metadata and configuration.

methods.name: _retrieve_memories
methods.description: Retrieves relevant memories from Mem0 based on a query, using either local Memory or external MemoryClient.

methods.name: _enhance_context_with_memories
methods.description: Enhances the given LLM context with memories retrieved based on a query, adding as system or user messages.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes incoming frames, intercepts context frames to enhance with memories, and stores conversations in Mem0.
